<!-- pr-reviewer: aef4f610c39c6fe529092a3780e0c38ec6498e06 -->
**Review: clean. Verdict: merge-ready.** Reviewed by the SlaveSession PR-reviewer agent (built review). This PR is from an account that is not a collaborator: the maintainer approves and merges by hand.

**Built.** Head `aef4f610c`, merged cleanly with `main` in a reviewer worktree (trial merge: no conflicts).
- `camcraft-app`: `model_link` 7 passed, `sketch_project` 14 passed, `continuous_4axis_part` 10 passed. 0 failed.
- `camcraft-ui` lib tests: 1224 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. No test deleted or ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-geometry --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Law checks.**
- Commands: `SetModelSource` is one undo step, keyed by name, refuses by name (unknown model, not a model, unreadable file, unlink of an unlinked model). `ImportModel`, `UpdateModel`, `DeleteEntity` and `ImportFixture` carry the source through apply and invert. The history is the single source of truth.
- Layers: the UI queues `CommandKind::UnlinkModel` and `ImportFile`; the MCP tool runs the same app command. No `sys_*` or world-level calls in UI code.
- Project file: v71 to v72 steps up unchanged; a bad source row is refused as corrupt; an old reader refuses v72 by name. `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj` is rewritten to 72 with the version-pin test kept green.
- Prime Directive: no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the new files. A missing or unreadable file keeps the model and is said one time. Degenerate and corrupt cases give errors.
- MCP: `set_model_link` ships with the new command; the `camcraft-mcp` skill row is in the diff. `Process change: yes` is in the body and `PROCESS_VERSION` is not touched.
- Provenance lines are on each new file. No new crate dependency; the digest is the kernel's SHA-256 re-export.

**Findings (not blockers).**
1. `ImportModel::within` reads the file a second time for the digest, after the parse. A change between the two reads is missed (the newer digest rides the older mesh). Filed as #2689 (`P3`, `effort:medium`).
2. This PR adds one Browser menu row (Unlink from ...). A screenshot of the row in the body would help the record. The behaviour tests pin the menu action, so this does not hold the PR.
3. Note for the merge order: other open PRs may also raise `PROJECT_VERSION`. If one reaches `main` with 72 first, this PR moves to the next number at its refresh.

The linked check runs once each second and reads a file only when its size or time moved. That matches the frame-cost rule (#2238).

Breaking for the next release notes: this PR raises the project file to version 72, and older CamCraft builds refuse a v72 file (`unsupported project version 72`). The merge commit has no `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer, so the cut must list it under breaking changes.
